name: @meridian/layout
description: Meridian layout engine (ROADMAP Phase 4): turns a cut + induced edges into stable world-space positions as pure functions. Phase 4B ships the LayoutProvider contract, grid/tree deterministic providers, the ADR-0016 stability scorer, and a DOM-free SVG exporter. Imports @meridian/abstraction and @meridian/graph-core types only (ADR-0015).
